title: QUIZ - 66
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Evaluating Formulas for a Given Input
questions.learningObjective: Evaluate a linear formula's output for a specified input value
questions.question: Given \( f(t) = 2t + 9 \), what is f(2)?
questions.hint: Substitute the given input directly into the formula and simplify.

questions.concept: Evaluating Real-World Formulas for Outputs
questions.learningObjective: Compute a real-world total by evaluating a formula at a specific input
questions.question: A delivery service charges $95 plus $30 per package. What is the total bill for 5 packages (t = 5)?
questions.hint: Multiply the rate by the input, then add the fixed amount.
